text:
The food is in a stainless steel mixing bowl, probably about 22 cm across at the rim. The food itself covers roughly 10-12 cm.

It looks like tuna or shredded chicken mixed with shredded carrot, cherry tomatoes, and almonds. There also seems to be a piece of seasoned or dark-crusted fish or meat on the right side.

I estimate about 200 g in total: roughly 120 g of tuna or chicken, 30 g of carrot, 3 cherry tomatoes at about 40 g, a few almonds at about 8 g, and a seasoned piece of about 20 g.

For energy, flaked tuna or chicken at about 1.3 kcal/g gives roughly 160 kcal. Carrot adds about 12, tomatoes about 8, and almonds about 45. The seasoned piece adds about 30, and any dressing or mayonnaise could add around 50. That brings the total to roughly 300 kcal.
